# SurfaceGuard 0.2.0

SurfaceGuard 0.2.0 strengthens bounded scanning and makes Next.js App Router evidence match deployed URL paths.

Repeated literal and regular expression matches now stop at the configured finding limit before the complete match set is allocated. File-size limits apply before artifact classification, Unicode and malformed percent-encoding preserve exact raw evidence offsets, and zero-width regular expressions advance by complete code points.

The Next.js adapter now removes route groups and parallel slots, resolves interception markers, strips App Router leaf markers, and omits the framework not-found entry. Pages Router paths remain unchanged.

This release also rejects unsupported compressed sitemaps as evidence for a required sitemap, aligns file-rule message validation with the policy schema, adds complete-history Gitleaks CI, updates pinned workflow actions, and corrects release-note lookup for versioned tags.

The attached package is for direct GitHub installation. This release is not published to npm or another package registry.
